# Elements: Layout, structure and containers

> Plainkit 0.1.0-alpha.1. Generated by scripts/build-skills.mjs from core/dist/elements/api.json. Do not edit: change the source and run the generator.

Every element also takes the usual HTML global attributes (`id`, `class`, `slot`, `hidden`, `aria-*`, `data-*`). Never use a `style` attribute (the CSP blocks it): use props, parts and CSS custom properties.

## `pk-accordion`

**Accordion** (Containers). A stack of collapsible sections; exclusive mode keeps one open.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `exclusive` | `exclusive` | boolean | `false` |  | Opening one item closes the others. |
| `flush` | `flush` | boolean | `false` |  | No gaps: one shared frame. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | pk-accordion-item children. |

**Accessibility.** Each item is a native details and summary, so Enter and Space toggle it and find-in-page opens matches. The accordion only coordinates the items.

Example: Exclusive

```html
<pk-accordion exclusive>
  <pk-accordion-item heading="Shipping" open>Ships in 2 days.</pk-accordion-item>
  <pk-accordion-item heading="Returns">30 days.</pk-accordion-item>
</pk-accordion>
```

## `pk-accordion-item`

**Accordion item** (Containers). One collapsible section on a native details element, with an animated panel where the browser supports it.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `heading` | `heading` | string | `""` |  | Header text. |
| `open` | `open` | boolean | `false` |  | Expanded. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | The panel. |
| `heading` | A rich heading; overrides heading. |
| `icon` | An icon before the heading. |

**Events** (`addEventListener`; `pk-*` events are CustomEvents whose `detail` is shown)

| Event | Detail | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-toggle` | `{ open: bool }` | The section opened or closed. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `details` | The details element. |
| `summary` | The clickable header. |
| `heading` | The heading text. |
| `chevron` | The chevron. |
| `panel` | The content wrapper. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-accordion-duration` | `0.2s` | Open and close time. |

**Accessibility.** Native details and summary semantics with a 44px header; the chevron is decorative. The animation is skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.

Example: Open by default

```html
<pk-accordion-item heading="Returns" open>30 days, unopened.</pk-accordion-item>
```

## `pk-app-shell`

**App shell** (Layout & structure). The page frame: nav column, header, one scrolling body and footer. Header and footer stay put; safe-area insets are added on notched phones; a slotted control marked data-nav-toggle opens the side nav drawer.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `nav-open` | `navOpen` | boolean | `false` |  | Drawer state, mirrors the side nav. |
| `flush` | `flush` | boolean | `false` |  | Removes the body padding so a workspace, table or map sits edge to edge (the safe-area insets on a notched phone stay). |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `nav` | A pk-side-nav. |
| `header` | Top bar content. |
| (default) | The scrolling body. |
| `footer` | Footer content. |

**Events** (`addEventListener`; `pk-*` events are CustomEvents whose `detail` is shown)

| Event | Detail | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-nav-toggle` | `{ open: boolean }` | A data-nav-toggle control was pressed. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `main` | Main column |
| `header` | Header row |
| `body` | Main content |
| `footer` | Footer row |

**Accessibility.** Landmarks: header, main content region and footer are exposed; only the body scrolls, so there is never a nested scrollbar; the skip link belongs first in the header slot.

Example: App shell with a sticky footer

```html
<pk-app-shell><pk-side-nav slot="nav" label="Main"><a slot="brand" href="#">App</a><pk-nav-item href="#" current>Home</pk-nav-item><pk-nav-item href="#">Reports</pk-nav-item></pk-side-nav><div slot="header"><pk-button data-nav-toggle aria-label="Open the menu" variant="ghost">Menu</pk-button></div><pk-stack><h1>Home</h1><p>Content scrolls here; the header and footer stay put.</p></pk-stack><span slot="footer">Plainkit</span></pk-app-shell>
```

## `pk-card`

**Card** (Containers). A titled panel with optional media, header actions and footer. Vertical or horizontal (stacking by its own width), flush for tables, and optionally one link.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `heading` | `heading` | string | `""` |  | The card title. Without it (and without actions) the header is not shown. |
| `level` | `level` | number | `2` |  | The heading level the title exposes to assistive technology (aria-level). |
| `tone` | `tone` | enum | `"default"` | `default` `error` | error draws the border in the error colour. |
| `orientation` | `orientation` | enum | `"vertical"` | `vertical` `horizontal` | Horizontal puts the media beside the content; it stacks when the card is narrower than 30rem (a container query, not the viewport). |
| `flush` | `flush` | boolean | `false` |  | No padding around the body, for a table or an edge-to-edge body; the heading row keeps its padding. |
| `href` | `href` | string | `""` |  | Makes the whole card one link (a single tab stop named by the heading). |
| `fill` | `fill` | boolean | `false` |  | Fills a flex parent (a workspace pane): the card takes the remaining height, has no padding, and its body is the scroll region. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | The card body. |
| `media` | An image, picture or video at the top (or the start when horizontal). |
| `actions` | Buttons or links at the right of the header. |
| `footer` | Content below the body; hidden when empty. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `card` | The panel. |
| `header` | The header row. |
| `title` | The title. |
| `body` | The body wrapper. |
| `footer` | The footer wrapper. |
| `media` | The media wrapper; hidden when empty. |
| `content` | The padded content column (header, body, footer). |
| `link` | The overlay link when href is set. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-card-bg` | `var(--color-panel)` | Panel background. |
| `--pk-card-padding` | `var(--space-4) 1.25rem` | Panel padding. |
| `--pk-card-radius` | `var(--radius-md)` | Corner radius. |
| `--pk-card-media-width` | `40%` | Media width in the horizontal layout. |

**Accessibility.** The title is exposed as a heading whose level you choose with level, so the card fits the page outline wherever it sits. With href the card holds one link named by the heading, so there is a single tab stop and no nested interactive content.

Example: Titled card with an action

```html
<pk-card heading="Shipping">
  <pk-button slot="actions" size="mini" variant="ghost">Edit</pk-button>
  <p>Ships within two business days.</p>
</pk-card>
```

Example: Error tone with a footer

```html
<pk-card heading="Sync failed" tone="error">
  <p>The channel rejected the update.</p>
  <pk-button slot="footer" size="mini">Retry</pk-button>
</pk-card>
```

Example: Media, horizontal

```html
<pk-card heading="Widget 1" orientation="horizontal">
  <svg slot="media" viewBox="0 0 4 3" role="img" aria-label="Cover"><rect width="4" height="3" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.15"></rect></svg>
  <p>First printing, near mint.</p>
</pk-card>
```

## `pk-cluster`

**Cluster** (Layout). A wrapping row (or column) of controls with a fixed gap: the layout primitive for button rows, chip lists and toolbars.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `direction` | `direction` | enum | `"horizontal"` | `horizontal` `vertical` | Row (wraps at the edge) or column. |
| `gap` | `gap` | enum | `"sm"` | `none` `xs` `sm` `md` `lg` `xl` | Space between children, on the spacing scale (none 0, xs --space-1, sm --space-2, md --space-4, lg --space-6, xl --space-8). Default sm (the control gap). |
| `align` | `align` | enum | `"center"` | `start` `center` `end` `stretch` `baseline` | Cross-axis alignment of the items. |
| `justify` | `justify` | enum | `"start"` | `start` `center` `end` `between` | Main-axis distribution of the items. |
| `nowrap` | `nowrap` | boolean | `false` |  | Keep a horizontal cluster on one line instead of wrapping (wrapping is the default). |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | The items to lay out. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-cluster-gap` | `the gap token` | Overrides the gap prop with any length. |

**Accessibility.** A plain layout box with no role and no focus behaviour; keep the DOM order the reading order.

Example: Wrapping row

```html
<pk-cluster gap="sm"><pk-button>One</pk-button><pk-button variant="ghost">Two</pk-button><pk-badge>Three</pk-badge></pk-cluster>
```

Example: Spread to the ends

```html
<pk-cluster justify="between"><span>Left</span><pk-button>Right</pk-button></pk-cluster>
```

Example: Vertical

```html
<pk-cluster direction="vertical" gap="xs" align="start"><pk-badge>First</pk-badge><pk-badge>Second</pk-badge></pk-cluster>
```

## `pk-divider`

**Divider** (Layout). A rule between content, horizontal or vertical, with an optional label.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vertical` | `vertical` | boolean | `false` |  | A vertical rule; the parent must be a flex row. |
| `label-position` | `labelPosition` | enum | `"center"` | `center` `start` | Where the label sits. |
| `decorative` | `decorative` | boolean | `false` |  | Remove the separator role. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | The label. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `line` | A rule. |
| `label` | The label. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-divider-color` | `var(--color-border)` | Line colour. |
| `--pk-divider-gap` | `var(--space-3)` | Space around the label. |

**Accessibility.** role=separator (with aria-orientation) unless decorative is set.

Example: Labelled

```html
<pk-divider>or</pk-divider>
```

Example: Plain

```html
<pk-divider></pk-divider>
```

## `pk-grid`

**Grid** (Layout). Equal-width responsive columns: as many columns of at least min as fit, one column on a phone.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `min` | `min` | string | `"16rem"` |  | Minimum column width as a CSS length (for example 12rem or 200px). Columns are equal width and never narrower than this, so the grid drops to one column when the container is narrower than two. |
| `columns` | `columns` | number | `0` |  | The most columns to use, 0 for no limit. The grid still drops columns when they would be narrower than min. |
| `ratio` | `ratio` | string | `""` |  | Unequal columns as a ratio, for example 2:1 (a wide main column and a narrow side) or 1:2:1. Empty keeps equal auto-fit columns. Overrides min and columns; on a phone (640px and below) the grid falls back to auto columns so it stacks. |
| `gap` | `gap` | enum | `"md"` | `none` `xs` `sm` `md` `lg` `xl` | Space between children, on the spacing scale (none 0, xs --space-1, sm --space-2, md --space-4, lg --space-6, xl --space-8). Default md (the card gap). |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | The items to lay out. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-grid-min` | `16rem` | The column minimum; set by the min prop. |
| `--pk-grid-columns` | `unset (no cap)` | The column cap; set by the columns prop. |
| `--pk-grid-ratio` | `unset (auto-fit columns)` | The explicit column list; set by the ratio prop. |

**Accessibility.** A plain layout box with no role; the DOM order is the reading order, so a single column on a phone keeps the same order.

Example: Auto columns

```html
<pk-grid min="10rem"><pk-card heading="One">A</pk-card><pk-card heading="Two">B</pk-card><pk-card heading="Three">C</pk-card><pk-card heading="Four">D</pk-card></pk-grid>
```

Example: A 2:1 split

```html
<pk-grid ratio="2:1"><pk-card heading="Main">Wide</pk-card><pk-card heading="Side">Narrow</pk-card></pk-grid>
```

Example: At most three columns

```html
<pk-grid columns="3" min="8rem" gap="lg"><pk-card heading="A">1</pk-card><pk-card heading="B">2</pk-card><pk-card heading="C">3</pk-card><pk-card heading="D">4</pk-card></pk-grid>
```

## `pk-page-header`

**Page header** (Layout & structure). The top of a page, a section or a record: a breadcrumb row, a title bar with actions, and a note line. Stacks by its own width, with the actions full width and touch-sized on a phone.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `heading` | `heading` | string | `""` |  | The title. Without it (and without default or actions content) the title bar is not shown. |
| `level` | `level` | number | `2` |  | The heading level the title exposes to assistive technology (aria-level). |
| `variant` | `variant` | enum | `"page"` | `page` `section` `record` | page is the standard page top; section is a titled section inside a page (title, actions, note); record is the compact strip of a single-record page (chips on the left, actions right). |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | Beside the title: status chips, badges or your own heading element. |
| `breadcrumb` | A pk-breadcrumb (or any trail) above the title; hidden when empty. |
| `actions` | Buttons at the right of the title bar; full width and touch-sized on a narrow container. |
| `meta` | A note or metadata line under the title bar; hidden when empty. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `header` | The header element. |
| `crumbs` | The breadcrumb row. |
| `titlebar` | The row holding the title and the actions. |
| `lead` | The title and the default slot. |
| `title` | The title. |
| `actions` | The actions wrapper. |
| `meta` | The note line. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-page-header-padding` | `var(--space-1) 0` | Padding of the header. |
| `--pk-page-header-title-size` | `var(--text-lg)` | Title font size. |

**Accessibility.** The header is a header element, not a banner landmark, so it is safe inside main. The title is exposed as a heading whose level you choose with level, so it fits the page outline (use 1 for a page, 2 or 3 for a section). Give the breadcrumb slot a pk-breadcrumb, which is its own labelled navigation landmark.

Example: Page: crumbs, title and actions

```html
<pk-page-header heading="PO 1042" level="1">
  <pk-breadcrumb slot="breadcrumb">
    <a href="#">Stock</a>
    <a href="#">Purchase orders</a>
    <span aria-current="page">PO 1042</span>
  </pk-breadcrumb>
  <pk-button slot="actions">Receive</pk-button>
  <pk-button slot="actions" variant="ghost">Print</pk-button>
</pk-page-header>
```

Example: Section: title, action and note

```html
<pk-page-header variant="section" heading="Stock movements">
  <pk-button slot="actions" size="mini" variant="ghost">Refresh</pk-button>
  <span slot="meta">Latest 50 · in 40 / out 28</span>
</pk-page-header>
```

Example: Record: status chips and actions

```html
<pk-page-header variant="record">
  <pk-badge>Open</pk-badge>
  <span>Acme Supply</span>
  <pk-button slot="actions" size="mini" variant="ghost">Print</pk-button>
  <pk-button slot="actions" size="mini">Receive</pk-button>
</pk-page-header>
```

## `pk-stack`

**Stack** (Layout). A vertical stack of children with an even gap: the layout primitive for form sections, card bodies and page columns.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gap` | `gap` | enum | `"md"` | `none` `xs` `sm` `md` `lg` `xl` | Space between children, on the spacing scale (none 0, xs --space-1, sm --space-2, md --space-4, lg --space-6, xl --space-8). Default md (the flow space). |
| `align` | `align` | enum | `"stretch"` | `stretch` `start` `center` `end` | Cross-axis alignment: stretch fills the width, the others size each child to its content. |
| `dividers` | `dividers` | boolean | `false` |  | Draw a rule between children. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | The items to lay out. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-stack-gap` | `the gap token` | Overrides the gap prop with any length. |
| `--pk-stack-divider` | `var(--color-border)` | Colour of the dividers. |

**Accessibility.** A plain layout box with no role; the rules from dividers are decorative borders, not separators, so add pk-divider where a separator should be announced.

Example: Even rhythm

```html
<pk-stack gap="md"><p>First paragraph.</p><p>Second paragraph.</p><p>Third paragraph.</p></pk-stack>
```

Example: With dividers

```html
<pk-stack gap="sm" dividers><div>Profile</div><div>Billing</div><div>Notifications</div></pk-stack>
```

## `pk-toolbar`

**Toolbar** (Layout & structure). A row with a lead (title and note) on the left and actions on the right. It wraps by its own width and stacks on a phone, with touch-sized actions.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `heading` | `heading` | string | `""` |  | The lead title, in strong text. |
| `note` | `note` | string | `""` |  | A muted note beside the title, such as a count. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | More lead content after the title and note (filters, chips). |
| `actions` | Buttons at the right; hidden when empty, full width and touch-sized on a narrow container. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `toolbar` | The row. |
| `lead` | The title, note and default slot. |
| `title` | The title. |
| `note` | The note. |
| `actions` | The actions wrapper. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-toolbar-margin` | `var(--space-1) 0 var(--space-3) 0` | Outer margin of the row. |

**Accessibility.** A plain group of controls, not an ARIA toolbar (which would need arrow-key roving): every action is a normal tab stop in reading order. The title is text, not a heading; use pk-page-header when the outline needs one.

Example: Title, note and actions

```html
<pk-toolbar heading="Lines" note="12 lines on this order">
  <pk-button slot="actions" size="mini" variant="ghost">Export</pk-button>
  <pk-button slot="actions" size="mini">Add line</pk-button>
</pk-toolbar>
```

Example: Title only

```html
<pk-toolbar heading="Recent activity"></pk-toolbar>
```

## `pk-workspace`

**Workspace** (Layout & structure). A tool page in panes: a nav pane, a main pane and an optional docked aside, each scrolling on its own. On a phone one pane shows at a time and a tab strip (Contents, Content, Details) switches it.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fill` | `fill` | boolean | `false` |  | Fill the height the parent gives it (a parent with a definite height, or a flex or grid parent) and drop the frame, for a tool that owns the whole page. Without it the workspace is as tall as the viewport minus a reserve. |
| `active-pane` | `activePane` | enum | `"main"` | `nav` `main` `aside` | The pane shown on a phone. On a wider screen every pane shows. A pane that does not exist falls back to the main pane. |
| `aside-open` | `asideOpen` | boolean | `false` |  | Show the aside: a docked column on a wide screen, a panel over the main pane on a tablet and its own pane on a phone. |
| `nav-label` | `navLabel` | string | `"Contents"` |  | The nav pane's accessible name and its tab on a phone. |
| `main-label` | `mainLabel` | string | `"Content"` |  | The main pane's accessible name and its tab on a phone. |
| `aside-label` | `asideLabel` | string | `"Details"` |  | The aside's accessible name and its tab on a phone. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `nav` | The nav pane: a file tree, a list of sections, filters. Leave it out for a two-pane workspace. |
| (default) | The main pane. |
| `aside` | The docked aside (an inspector or a details panel). It shows when asideOpen is set. |

**Events** (`addEventListener`; `pk-*` events are CustomEvents whose `detail` is shown)

| Event | Detail | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-pane-change` | `{ pane: string, previous: string }` | A tab in the phone strip was chosen. Cancelable: preventDefault keeps the previous pane. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `root` | The frame that lays the panes out. |
| `strip` | The phone tab strip. |
| `tab` | One tab in the strip. |
| `nav` | The nav pane. |
| `main` | The main pane. |
| `aside` | The aside pane. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-workspace-height` | `calc(100dvh - 20rem)` | Height when fill is not set. |
| `--pk-workspace-nav-w` | `17.5rem` | Width of the nav column on a wide screen. |
| `--pk-workspace-aside-w` | `var(--inspector-w)` | Width of the aside. |
| `--pk-workspace-pad` | `var(--pad-panel)` | Padding inside each pane (the default of the three below). |
| `--pk-workspace-nav-pad` | `var(--pk-workspace-pad)` | Padding inside the nav pane; 0 for a pane that fills itself. |
| `--pk-workspace-main-pad` | `var(--pk-workspace-pad)` | Padding inside the main pane. |
| `--pk-workspace-aside-pad` | `var(--pk-workspace-pad)` | Padding inside the aside pane. |

**Accessibility.** Each pane is a labelled region (the aside a complementary landmark) and scrolls on its own, so it is reachable by keyboard. On a phone the strip is a tablist with a roving tabindex: Left and Right (or Up and Down), Home and End move between tabs and select them; each pane becomes a tabpanel labelled by its tab. Tabs are 44px high. Hidden panes are display:none, so they are out of the tab order and the accessibility tree.

Example: Nav and main

```html
<pk-workspace nav-label="Sections">
  <div slot="nav" class="stack"><a href="#overview">Overview</a><a href="#channels">Channels</a><a href="#integrations">Integrations</a></div>
  <div class="stack"><h2>Overview</h2><p>The main pane scrolls on its own. Below 640px only the nav or this pane shows, switched by the strip above.</p></div>
</pk-workspace>
```

Example: With a docked aside

```html
<pk-workspace aside-open nav-label="Files" aside-label="Outline">
  <div slot="nav" class="stack"><a href="#app">app.js</a><a href="#readme">README.md</a></div>
  <div class="stack"><h2>app.js</h2><p>The aside is a docked column on a wide screen, floats over the main pane on a tablet and is its own pane on a phone.</p></div>
  <div slot="aside" class="stack"><h3>Outline</h3><p>run()</p></div>
</pk-workspace>
```
